approval_ref: The active user goal requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements for RFI, Submittal and email content.
notes: A generic-subject email whose body starts with a Submittal heading is currently routed to a later RFI heading because body lookup is type-prioritized instead of position-ordered.
Keep explicit email Subject precedence; when no explicit workflow Subject exists, select the earliest supported body heading regardless of workflow type.
Reuse existing deterministic matches and their positions; add no dependency, semantic inference, mailbox access or model call.
Offline parser and API regressions, specification sync and every bounded task context pack passed before completion.
title: Body heading order for workflow routing
objective: Route a generic-subject email or text document by its earliest explicit supported body heading instead of always preferring a later RFI over an earlier Submittal.
